title: A call signal is dropped on the receiving side: no VTCCall is projected for a call room the agent was invited to
design:
FOUND 2026-11-25 by reading, while starting bead mimid-1wgh.114.10's
test. Not yet reproduced by a test; that test is the reproduction and is
the next step.

THE MECHANISM. crates/mimid-agent-jmap/src/vtc_stream.rs, the pump that
turns a Change::CallSignal into a pushed VTCCallSignal:

    let Some(call) = chat.call_of_room(&room).await else {
        continue;
    };

call_of_room finds a VtcCall whose mimiRoomId names that room. The agent
that CREATED the call has one, because VTCCall/set create made it. The
agent on the OTHER side has none: Store::start_call invites the chat's
people to the call room, so bob joins it and his store gets the signals
as messages, but nothing ever makes a VtcCall record for a call room he
did not create.

So every incoming signal hits that `continue` and is dropped. Bob opens
the socket, sends VTCStreamEnable, and receives nothing. A call cannot
connect in either direction.

THE DESIGN ALREADY SAYS WHAT SHOULD HAPPEN. call_of_room's own doc
comment names this case: "or None when no call of this account has that
room: a chat, or a call room this agent is in WITHOUT A VTCCALL OF ITS
OWN, which is what a call hosted by another of the user's clients looks
like UNTIL ITS RECORDS ARE PROJECTED." The projection is the missing
piece, not the lookup.

WHERE IT BELONGS. crates/mimid-agent-jmap/src/project.rs projects rooms
to Chats and skips call rooms (`Render::is_call_room`, two places). A
call room should instead project a VTCCall: state active, callType room,
chatId the parent chat's key, mimiRoomId the room's URI — the same fields
VtcBackend::create_call sets, from the room rather than from a client's
create. Then call_of_room finds it on both sides, VTCCall/get lists it,
and VTCCall/exportMediaSecret works for a participant who did not start
the call.

WHAT TO BE CAREFUL ABOUT:

• The id must be stable across restarts and the same every time the room
  is projected, or a client's callId changes under it. The projection of
  other types already faces this; follow whatever it does rather than
  minting a fresh Id.
• Room::parent gives the chat the call hangs under; a call room whose
  parent this agent is not in should project nothing it cannot name.
• Do not project a Chat for the call room as well: that is what
  is_call_room exists to prevent, and a call room showing up as a chat
  in every client is the bug it was added for.
• decision mimid-1wgh.111's cascade window: leaving the chat is not
  leaving the call, so a projected VTCCall must not disappear the moment
  the parent chat does.

RELATED BUT NOT THE SAME: bead mimid-1wgh.114.1 announces a call in the
parent chat, which is how a HUMAN learns a call started. This is how the
CLIENT gets the record it needs to act on. A client could not use the
announcement without this.
close_reason: Fixed in the commit above; the regression test is tests/vtc_negotiation.rs (bead mimid-1wgh.114.10), which failed on each of the three in turn.
